title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates the absence of controls over tools and Work IQ, for which Microsoft documents policy-based governance. It also asserts that administrators cannot enforce human assistance without supporting documentation, and incorrectly limits the node to published agents despite its documented inline-agent option. The roadmap facts and the cited credit-allocation API check out.
